subject: delta(client): WF let the explicit resume proof through the HTTPS connector and refuse to prepare terms without a seller transport
note: The HTTPS connector's request header allowlist now admits x-dacs-seller-resume, so the proof the seller client adds to the first attempt of an explicit protocolRecheck resume reaches the seller; every other header outside accept, content-type, x-dacs-seller-peer and x-dacs-seller-resume is still refused before anything is sent. prepareTerms now refuses with seller_agent_unavailable, before anything is signed or saved, any terms that declare no seller transport, not only payable ones: the transport is declared only together with native payment and its evidence, and without it no seller request could be authenticated, so the default unpaid configuration used to pass prepare and identity and plan signing and then fail at its first Agreement submit with a bare TypeError. Test worlds that prepare a purchase (the public composition world and the kit-client purchase world) now compose native payment, payment evidence and a declared seller transport. The packed archive test of createPublicSellerClient installs npm's lock recomputed for its own app, as the other packed test on the Node 24 leg does, because Node 24's npm refuses the workspace lock copied as it is.
